final_message: I parsed the log file by reading each entry's first line to extract timestamp, service, level, and message. I collected any indented lines as part of the entry and summed repeats from following "-- last message repeated N times --" lines. I filtered entries to include only those with levels ERROR, SEVERE, or FATAL (case insensitive). I converted timestamps to UTC in the required format, normalized levels to uppercase, and extracted the message after the last " | " separator. I calculated repeat_count as 1 plus the sum of repeats and aggregated counts by service. The results were written to workspace/errors.json following the specified structure and Acme conventions.
